# Blog — Claude Code Context

## Source of truth: org files, not markdown

**Never edit `.md` files in `site/content/` directly.** They are generated by ox-hugo and will be overwritten on the next export. All post content lives in the `.org` files in this directory.

Workflow:
1. Edit or create a `.org` file here (e.g. `sorting-algorithms.org`)
2. Export to Hugo markdown: `bash export.sh` (all files) or `bash export.sh mypost.org` (one file)
3. Preview: `cd site && hugo server`

`setup-blog.org` is shared config — it is skipped by `export.sh` automatically.

## Hugo site

The Hugo site lives at `site/`. Layout overrides and partials are in `site/layouts/` — those can be edited directly since they are not generated.

## Figures

LaTeX figures live in `figures/src/*.tex`. Render to SVG with `bash render-figures.sh`. Output goes to `site/static/figures/`.
